newsitem.title: USA: MCI wins Charles Schwab contract.
newsitem.headline: MCI wins Charles Schwab contract.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said it had signed a three-year telecommunications deal with discount brokerage Charles Schwab Corp worth tens of millions of dollars. It declined to give a precise figure.

MCI said it would supply 1-800 services, virtual private networks -- internal communications systems carried on a public network -- video conferencing and systems integration, replacing Sprint Corp and AT&T Corp.
However an MCI spokesman confirmed that Schwab continues to use all three long distance providers in other areas.
Schwab's touchtone broking system, which automatically switches calls to the appropriate call center, will be based on MCI's network.
